title: Massive errors (hundreds of errors!) after submitting the game to Google Play
body: ### Tested versions Godot 4.4.1 Stable, 4.5 Beta 1..4 Exported on Linux Ubuntu 22.04 Running on Android ### System information Android ### Issue description After sending the game to Google Play, there were massive crashes on a wide variety of devices and OS versions. It was already in my other game (#101529). I started the project from scratch, made it absolutely clean, but the situation is the same. I'm not well versed in the topics of engine compilation and everything else, I'm a designer and Godot gives me the most important thing - a convenient GDScript. However, the game is very unstable and I do not know why. These problems didn't exist before when I was making games on 3,5,2. Unfortunately, I couldn't play it myself either on my phone or in the emulator. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I don't have a minimal project, as I can't reproduce the error on my own. This happens for players on Google Play. The Game - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pn.games.exsignal
